subject: Syntax for xlim with date + time in the 0.9 paradigm?

messages.author: afa289b81aad98c2
messages.subject: Syntax for xlim with date + time in the 0.9 paradigm?
parts: I don't work with dates much, and this may be something I should know, but if I want to plot my x axis with an xlim and the x data is date + time, what's the syntax for xlim?  I've manually limited the data frame to get the job done in the mean time, but I was wondering.  Didn't see this topic on this list (recently) and I don't see it in the transition guide.  Thanks, Bryan

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Syntax for xlim with date + time in the 0.9 paradigm?
parts:
Hi Bryan:

There's probably more than one way to do this, but here's a toy
example to illustrate one.

tms <- seq(as.POSIXct("2012-06-01 0:00:00"), as.POSIXct("2012-06-07 23:00:00"),
by = "hours")
DF <- data.frame(tms, y = rnorm(168))
ggplot(DF, aes(x = tms, y = y)) + geom_point() + geom_line() +
xlim(as.POSIXct("2012-05-30 12:00:00"), as.POSIXct("2012-06-09 12:00:00"))

If you wanted to change the form of the date axis labels, then look
into scale_x_datetime().

HTH,
Dennis
